description: This file defines the TimesheetActionLogAPI class, which implements an API endpoint for retrieving action logs associated with a specific timesheet in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for handling GET requests to fetch logs, validation rules, and access control logic, and uses traits for timesheet services and user role management.
